tools.name: check_audit_status
tools.description: Check the audit status of an npm package version via the AuPM proxy. Returns status (UNREVIEWED/COMMUNITY_REVIEWED/PEER_REVIEWED), auditor address, and attestation txid. Free — no payment required.

tools.name: install_audited_package
tools.description: Install an npm package via AuPM. If COMMUNITY_REVIEWED or higher, this route returns 402. Opt in to donate up to $0.001 in USDC on Algorand MainNet (asset 31566704) as a plain asset transfer to the merchant payTo address. Without a donation opt-in, a 402 is reported back as status: 'donation_required' with the price and resource URL, and nothing is signed. Returns tarball path and settlement txid on a paid or free install. When a donation was asked for and failed, the tarball is the free one and the result carries donationFailure: { code, reason }. Nothing was paid. Donation setting: allowDonation in the call wins, true or false. Without it, the env var AUPM_DONATE (true or false) applies. Then 'donate = true' in $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/aupm/config.toml applies. If none is set, donation is off. A malformed env var or config file makes the call fail with an error.

allowDonation.description: Set true or false to override the AUPM_DONATE env var and the config file. Unset: they decide, and the default is off.

tools.name: attest_lockfile
tools.description: Request a signed in-toto attestation for a whole package-lock.json, pnpm-lock.yaml (lockfileVersion 9.0) or yarn.lock (yarn classic v1; chosen by file name) via AuPM. Free when the tree has zero reviewed packages. Opt in to donate to pay for and receive the full attestation. Without a donation opt-in, the reviewed entries are withheld and the result reports status: 'donation_required' with the partial attestation, the withheld count, the price, and the resource URL — never a 402. A paid attestation reports settlement: the settlement txid and the microUSDC amount paid. When a donation was asked for and failed, the result is the free one and carries donationFailure: { code, reason }. Nothing was paid. Donation setting: allowDonation in the call wins, true or false. Without it, the env var AUPM_DONATE (true or false) applies. Then 'donate = true' in $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/aupm/config.toml applies. If none is set, donation is off. A malformed env var or config file makes the call fail with an error.

lockfilePath.description: Path to a package-lock.json, a pnpm-lock.yaml (lockfileVersion 9.0) or a yarn.lock (yarn classic v1) on disk

allowDonation.description: Set true or false to override the AUPM_DONATE env var and the config file. Unset: they decide, and the default is off.
